title: Sam Walked Into Exam Day Covered In Blood And Went After Bobby . . . (Episode 8)
caption:
Weak Hero Class 1, episode 8: Max won't wake up, and Bobby's father covers the beating with a story about a training accident.
Sam hunts down Bobby's crew, beats Bobby in front of the whole school, then has to transfer to a new one. Follow for episode 9!

#weakhero #kdrama #kdramarecap #recap #spoilerroom
comment: Was Sam right to go after Bobby in front of everyone? Why?

segments.say: Sam walks into exam day covered in *blood*, and Bobby's whole crew panics.
To see how it got here, go back to a warm classroom, where Max jokes that Sam could *teach* better than their science teacher.
They plan to eat together tomorrow. Instead, Max ends up on a boxing ring *floor*.
Bobby's father sends his aide. Detectives will arrive soon, he says, so just do as you're *told*.
Then he hands the boys a story. Max was working out, took a break alone, and *passed out*.
They even text Sam from Max's phone. I'm working out, I'll call you *later*.
Max is carried away on a stretcher, and Bobby's crew walks off like nothing *happened*.
That lie was built to hold.
At home, Bobby's father screams at him, then tells the aide to watch him day and night until the plane to the *Philippines*.
Sam sits his final exams with a cast on his arm, rereading Max's text. Working out, call you *later*.
Then Amy calls, and Sam finally picks up. Max isn't working out. He won't *wake up*.
Amy tells him the rest. Bobby's people offered to pay the hospital bills, and made Max's grandma sign a *contract*.
Sam stands over Max's bed, and for the first time he can't *speak*.
Then the aide corners him in the hallway. If you want Max to stay alive, do what your father *says*.
That was a threat, plain and simple.
Back at school, Sam grabs one of Bobby's friends and demands *answers*.
Where is the athlete? In the gym, the kid says. I wasn't there, I swear. I only saw the *video*.
Wolf filmed the whole beating, and it is already going around *school*.
Then Amy throws herself in front of Bobby's car, and Sam screams at him to get *out*.
The aide drags Amy off the road. Let's go, Bobby's father says. Deal with *her*.
So Sam does the only thing left. He goes to the weight *room*.
He puts on the gloves, and he hears Max's voice. Guard your *chin*.
Max's advice was simple. If a fight comes, run. Sam looks at the gloves and says, no *way*.
Then the athlete walks in, and the two of them go at it on the gym *floor*.
When it ends, Sam is standing with blood on his shirt, and the athlete is *begging*.
Wait, he cries. Bobby kept kicking Max in the *head*. I had nothing to do with it.
Sam only says, don't apologize to *me*.
That was only the warm-up.
Meanwhile Bobby's father arrives at school, smiling at every teacher in the *line*.
A teacher repeats the cover story. Max trained with friends, took a break, and passed out. An accident. Oh dear, says Bobby's father. Is that *so*?
That man never even blinked.
Then the exam room goes quiet. The teacher stops mid-sentence. What is all that *blood*, Sam?
Bobby's crew panics. Calm down, they beg. We can *talk*.
Then somebody grabs a fire extinguisher and swings it at *Sam*.
It drops him, but Sam crawls back up and keeps *coming*.
He grabs Bobby by the shirt in front of the entire *class*.
Bobby tells him to just hit him. So Sam *does*.
Why did you do it, Sam asks. I don't know, Bobby says. You should *understand* me.
Then he keeps going. His fist is in a cast, and he is *crying* the whole time.
Teachers and students pour in to pull him *off*.
In the hallway, Sam finally breaks, crying in front of the whole *school*.
He held it in too long.
That night, Sam sits beside Max's bed and falls *asleep*.
Max is awake. After everything, the first thing they tell each other is *sorry*.
Sam tells him the rest. Bobby went abroad, and Amy said it was her fault before she *left*.
But Sam is not free. Bobby's father threatens him with juvie unless he transfers and keeps his *mouth shut*.
Thanks to that man's power, no school in Seoul will take him. The only one that does is *Eunjang*.
Sam walks in alone, and his mother tells him, you did nothing *wrong*.
His new class is a zoo. Boys scream, fight on desks, and nobody even looks up when the teacher walks *in*.
The teacher introduces the new kid. Say hello. I'm Sam, he says. Nice to meet *you*.
A smirking kid mocks his name. Are you a *girl*? You're our slave *now*.
Wrong boy to pick on.

segments.text: How come you guys are always so predictable?

segments.say: The bully asks if he wants his *tongue* ripped out, and Sam doesn't blink.
Somewhere else, a tattooed hand opens a photo of the new kid. He just beat one of our *candidates*, a voice says. So what do we do?
